blend.scout_rank: geometric mean of draft slot and consensus board rank (history: a board rank carries the same information as the slot; neither adds to the other)

outcome: first NBA season impact per 100 possessions as measured, rookies with 300+ minutes, weighted by minutes / (minutes + 500); selection into playing corrected (two-step, inverse Mills ratio) and left out of the projection: ability if he plays, not playing time

sources.college: Barttorvik player tables (barttorvik.com getadvstats CSV), final college season; team results
sources.nba_impact: Basketball Index LEBRON by season (fanspo.com/bbi-role-explorer/lebron), cached at data/research/bbi/captures/fanspo_tools/lebron/lebron_separate-seasons_raw_all-2010-2026.csv
sources.nba_minutes_bpm_draft: Basketball Reference advanced tables and draft pages (development_evidence.json, data/research/rookie_real_lines.json)
